note: Per-material baseline settings for OrcaSlicer filament presets. Identity fields and all extruder/bed temperatures are excluded -- those come from the spool record.

settings.description: This is neither a commonly used filament, nor one of Bambu filaments, and it varies a lot from brand to brand. So, it's highly recommended to ask its vendor for suitable profile before printing and adjust some parameters according to its performances.
